# AutiSpark

> > AutiSpark is a comprehensive digital learning platform offering games, interactive workbooks, and educational materials specifically designed for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

AutiSpark provides evidence-based learning tools including interactive games, printable worksheets, and workbooks that focus on visual discrimination, pattern recognition, fine motor skills, and cognitive development. The platform serves educators, therapists, and parents working with children on the autism spectrum.

## Key Topics

- Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
- Visual Discrimination
- Pattern Recognition
- Fine Motor Skills
- Matching Workbooks
- Sorting Activities
- Educational Games
- Special Education
- Interactive Learning
- Printable Workbooks
- Activity Workbooks
- Cognitive Development
- Autism Therapy
- Children's Learning Materials

## Core Learning Platform

- [AutiSpark - Games for Kids with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)](https://www.autispark.com): AutiSpark homepage: learning program for ASD with games, worksheets & activities
- [AutiSpark - One Year Unlimited Access](https://www.autispark.com/product/autispark-early-access): One-year subscription to AutiSpark app with unlimited access to games & workbooks

## Worksheets & Workbooks

- [Autism Worksheets For Kids - AutiSpark](https://www.autispark.com/autism/worksheets): Collection of autism worksheets for object identification and visual discrimination
- [Autism Workbooks For Kids - AutiSpark](https://www.autispark.com/autism/workbooks): Autism workbooks featuring sorting, classification, and activity exercises
- [Printed Workbooks - AutiSpark](https://www.autispark.com/printed-workbooks): Printed workbooks for special needs including pattern matching and learning skills

## Matching & Sorting Activities

- [Match Similar Pictures 1 – Matching Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/match-similar-pictures-1-matching-workbook): Matching workbook for visual skills and picture matching activities
- [Match Associated Pictures 1 – Matching Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/match-associated-pictures-1-matching-workbook): Matching workbook for picture association and cognitive skill development
- [Match The Sight Words #01 – Matching Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/match-the-sight-words-01-matching-workbook): Sight words matching workbook for reading skills and literacy practice
- [Sort By Class #01 – Sorting Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/sort-by-class-01-sorting-workbook): Sorting workbook for visual discrimination and classification activities
- [Circle Pictures By Function #01 – Sorting Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/circle-pictures-by-function-01-sorting-workbook): Sorting workbook for function-based picture categorization and visual discrimination

## Pattern & Tracing Activities

- [Complete The Alphabet Pattern Workbook #01 – Trace The Alphabet](https://www.autispark.com/product/complete-the-alphabet-pattern-workbook-01-trace-the-alphabet): Alphabet tracing workbook for pattern recognition and fine motor skill development
- [Complete The Color Pattern Workbook #01 – Color The Shapes](https://www.autispark.com/product/complete-the-color-pattern-workbook-01-color-the-shapes): Color pattern workbook for shape and color learning with pattern recognition
- [Match Number Patterns Workbook #01 – Trace The Numbers](https://www.autispark.com/product/match-number-patterns-workbook-01-trace-the-numbers): Number pattern matching workbook for tracing and pattern recognition skills
- [Complete The Number Pattern Workbook #01 – Trace The Numbers](https://www.autispark.com/product/complete-the-number-pattern-workbook-01-trace-the-numbers): Number pattern completion workbook for tracing and pattern recognition practice
- [Connect The Dots #02 – Activity Workbook](https://www.autispark.com/product/connect-the-dots-02-activity-workbook): Connect-the-dots activity workbook for number learning and fine motor skills
